## Updates while Scratchpad is open

- **Find updates sooner.** Scratchpad checks while it runs and after your Mac wakes or reconnects.
- **See when an update is ready.** The menu-bar icon marks an available update, and its menu shows when you can restart.
- **Install when you quit.** Turn on Install Updates on Quit in the Scratchpad menu to apply a verified update on your next safe quit.

- Quieter updates: a small pill replaces the update splash. It shows "Updating", then "Restart to update"; after an update a "What's new" pill lists what changed.
- Paste links with titles, or paste a list as separate items. Dash variants and colon headers are cleaned up when pasting lists.
- Optional weekly auto-clear of completed items (off by default), and a dot on the menu-bar icon when an update is available.

## Quieter list

- **Dashed circle for new items.** The new-item row is a simple dashed circle. The hint text only shows when the list is empty.
- **Gentler check-off.** A checked item shows its check and dims for a moment before it moves to Completed.
